avis.titre: Good on the go makeup remover

Also I realized a little goes a long way, which probably made it harder to take off with just water alone. I had to use water and a cloth to remove my makeup. Overall, it did remove my makeup as the product promised to, but next time I will use less and see if I could remove it with just water.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This balm does a decent job at removing makeup on its own. I found that it struggled to melt off mascara and eyeliner in my waterline. I also didn't use any face/base makeup in my trials but it did melt off any cream and liquid blushes I had on. Unlike most cleansing balms, water isn't required to mix with so this one doesn't emulsify/"lather up" and just melts into a cleansing oil in your hands/on your face. It doesn't leave the skin feeling super oily but this definitely requires a basic cleanser as a follow up.
